stories.title: Network appliances go more than a year without patches as exploits speed up
stories.why: The median vulnerability on enterprise network appliances stays unpatched for more than a year, Microsoft’s own telemetry shows, even as the most damaging software flaws are being weaponized within days of disclosure.

stories.title: CrowdStrike’s AI SOC vision evolves as agentic uncertainty adds new twist
stories.why: “The software we use has become an actor,” declared CrowdStrike President Michael Sentonas in his address on the dangers and opportunity of agentic AI at the company’s Fal.Con conference in September.

stories.title: CrowdStrike to acquire Fiddler, Dreadnode to extend AI security across agent lifecycle
stories.why: CrowdStrike plans to acquire AI security companies Fiddler AI and Dreadnode in separate deals that will extend its Falcon platform into automated testing of AI systems and monitoring of AI agent behaviour, as…

stories.title: Barracuda’s security appliances have a security problem of their own
stories.why: Barracuda, which offers a wide variety of cybersecurity devices, has been bitten by a bug itself.

stories.title: What AI-generated malware looks like under the microscope
stories.why: In this Help Net Security interview, Lindsay Kaye, VP of Threat Intelligence at HUMAN Security, talks about what AI-generated malware looks like on the bench.

stories.title: UK school estate hit by 3AM ransomware in suspected AI-assisted attack
stories.why: A 3AM ransomware affiliate targeted a school estate in the UK and successfully encrypted around 37 of nearly 50 machines reached from an unmanaged host.

stories.title: 3AM Ransomware Used Human-AI Hybrid Tactics in UK School Estate Compromise
stories.why: Bitdefender highlighted a unique human-AI approach during a September attack on a UK school estate, which resulted in financial data being exfiltrated

stories.title: Impart uses AI to build virtual patches without putting models in the traffic path
stories.why: Impart Security has launched the Runtime Defense Harness, a controlled environment where AI agents write and test virtual patches for new vulnerabilities without putting AI in the traffic path.

stories.title: WorkOS says attacker used ARTEX AI to breach internal sales app
stories.why: Developer platform WorkOS suffered a data breach after a threat actor accessed business contact records and summaries of customer communications.

stories.title: AI-Linked Breaches Mount as WorkOS, Northflank, Trigger.dev Disclose Hacks
stories.why: Hackers have been harvesting AI access tokens and have been using AI-assisted offensive tools to automate attacks.
